receipts.detail: scripts/test-execution-report.js owns schema lagrange-test-execution-report/v1, its writer (runner sections, producer report) and its validator executionReportProblems; scripts/run-test-files.js writes sections, run-release-proof.js, push-gate-change-proof.js reportedGateRun and publish-head.js writeLocalCorpusReport build reports through it; scripts/proof-authority.js recordProof validates through it. No second receipt format: the receipt gains an execution record inside the existing lagrange-proof-receipt schema. Ceiling: verdicts are recomputed from runner-written per-file results and runs, never a producer summary, but sections and report are written by the producer's own processes and are unsigned; reportDigest is an audit pointer, not an attestation; the planned manifest is producer-computed (plan-test-lane wholeCorpusFiles), recorded as a finding.

falsifiers absent, partial, schema, sha-mismatch, tree-mismatch, not-clean, identity-mismatch, identity-unverifiable, run-other-checkout, reused-proof and cli-without-report each refused with the typed execution-report-* code and no proof ref on the remote; red before the fix (red-before-fix.log: 17 of 18 failing) and red on revert (red-on-revert.log; red-on-revert-added-falsifiers.log for schema/not-clean/run-failed); attempt 2 adds malformed (CLI unparsable file and non-object report: execution-report-malformed, distinct from absent), empty-plan, started-not-planned and not-citable (per-contract sealed citableProofs; a cited proof must resolve exact-sha), each red under its guard's mutation (mutation-witnesses-attempt2.log.txt), plus a positive cited-corpus release receipt

falsifiers failed-command, run-failed, failed-file, skipped-file, zero-assertion and truncated refused with typed codes; a local-corpus rest run without its gate's cone report is a partial report (red-local-corpus-cone-missing.log before the fix); a green push-gate exit that ran nothing (as solve-land reuse does) leaves the planned corpus unexecuted (push-gate-change-proof.test.js); attempt 2: one file in two complete runs keeps the worst verdict in either order (failure, zero-assertion pass), red under last-wins and first-wins mutations

the runner keeps every attempt (first failure beside the retry pass); passed-on-retry is refused under the sealed REFUSE policy of release-full-v1 and corpus-full-v1; under ADMIT_QUALIFIED the receipt outcome is passed-qualified carrying the attempts and does not resolve as proven under a refusing contract; a test file never inherits the sections file, so a test's own nested runner never enters the proof report (red-nested-runner-sections.log before the fix); attempt 2 (verifier BLOCKING-1): resultsByFile merges every complete run's result order-independently (ok only if all ok, fewest assertions, every attempt of every run), so a retry pass in run 1 followed by a clean run 2, or the reverse, is refused as passed-on-retry; red before the fix in the order the old merge lost (red-attempt2-before-fix.log.txt) and red under last-wins and first-wins mutations

full-gate.yml uploads the gate's report and record_proof passes --report; publish-head recordProvedCorpus and runLocalCorpus, push-gate recordCorpusProof pass --report; run-release-proof writes the report and its hint; RELEASE.md local path records inside the exact checkout from its report. Old receipts resolve unchanged (reuse test), identity-catalogued reuse (release-proof-identity.test.js), canary resolveCorpusProof and release.yml checks are untouched; run-release-proof cites a reused corpus receipt which the authority re-resolves. Not exercised end to end: a live full-gate or check:release run.
